care.summary: Famous for its leaves that fold up at night like praying hands; beautiful patterned foliage with striking veins.
care.light: Bright indirect to medium light; no direct sun
care.water: Keep soil consistently moist; use distilled water to avoid leaf tip burn
care.soil: Well-draining, moisture-retentive potting mix with peat moss
care.humidity: High (60%+); thrives with regular misting or a pebble tray
care.fertilizer: Dilute balanced fertilizer monthly spring through fall
common_issues: Brown crispy leaf edges from low humidity or tap water
tips: Use distilled or rainwater to prevent fluoride damage
Observe the nightly prayer movement as a health indicator
